tasks.objective:
Implement the already confirmed N100 behavior as the next eligible task, never interrupt N71's current higher-priority work. The current PO says finish and move to the next work; do not let waiting-for-PO or an unrelated blocked account verification hold this independent approved task forever. Existing N71 shared-file ownership will serialize this task until its active phase ends. Do not reopen N73, N94, N97 or N98, which the PO already accepted.
N100 has two explicit copy choices: distribution definitions only (existing behavior), or copy definitions while preserving TARGET class student records. SOURCE class student grades must never be copied. For the confirmed label-only case, match a unique main item by normalized name and same recording representation/max, then preserve the TARGET subitem IDs and their completions/marks using first-to-first order when count/order/regular and late point values align; subitem names need NOT match. Replace the descriptive names/planned start and due dates as requested while retaining target marks and historical createdAt. This change must be correct in the server-owned plan/apply path, not a client-side rewrite of scores.
Use current src/views/items.js and src/store.js reviewScoreDistributionCopy/applyReviewedScoreDistribution, the existing distribution engine/cloud command and the current applied N73/N94 compatibility. First inspect the actual current source and complete plan fingerprint inputs, request/response schemas, atomic apply/receipt and restore serialization. Reuse the already tested active-account owner preflight; never weaken it or regress the approved Rakeez picker, chronological metadata, offline behavior, roster sorting, fresh-deletion identities or completed N71 work.
acceptance: Keep exactly two concise understandable UI choices, no extra multi-step wizard. Preview shows which target marks remain, copied names/startDate/dueDate and any ambiguity before confirmation. Source student scores never enter a target payload. Default behavior stays the existing definitions-only contract; do not silently change another teacher's usual mode or erase grades beyond that accepted contract.

Confirmed shape: same unique normalized main-item name, recording representation and max; same subitem count/order/points/latePoints. Match preserved origin identity first when unambiguous, otherwise ordinal correspondence for this label-only shape. Preserve TARGET subitem IDs, completion IDs/states, regular/late marks, manual grade additions and ownership/history. Copy planned startDate/dueDate as metadata, without retroactively recalculating a stored late/regular choice from the date. Existing target createdAt remains; newly added items get their actual creation time. Show truthful result counts.

Do not infer arbitrary matches from main name alone when count/order/types/weights differ or normalized name is duplicated. In preserve mode fail closed for that target mapping with a clear preview explanation, leaving its existing data intact. Newly created unmatched target definitions stay unmarked and existing unrelated items/grades remain; no silent deletion/reindex or mixing two students' records. The user may choose definitions-only knowingly; don't manufacture a successful preservation result for an incompatible target.

Native disposable PostgreSQL tests use ACTUAL current plan-builder and apply function sources: target regular/late/unmarked and manual marks survive rename/date-only changes; source and target students have deliberately different grades; repeated command exactly idempotent; stale fingerprint rejects all target mutations; multi-target all-or-nothing and owner isolation remain. Bind mode/mapping to server-owned request/plan/fingerprint so no caller-supplied score/target identity can evade verification. Existing migration files are immutable.

Actual account UI/store/guard flow is exercised with bounded synthetic transport and real application state, including expired lease/outbox and owner mismatches. No mocked ownership success. Reuse unchanged prior real A/B N73 evidence; do not create new Auth accounts/capabilities or test on the PO's classes. No extra comprehensive suite, no manual grade writes. Preserve both backup roundtrip and current server mapping for unchanged fields; do not create new mutable student metadata just to ease mapping.

If a service change is required, it is ONE additive transactional migration confined to existing distribution planning/apply/capability helpers described below and an optional mode/request field stored in existing plan JSON, with backward-compatible default. Certify exact functions and bindings locally first, apply once then read back source/hash/ACL/history. Never replay old N73/N94/N71 migrations or rewrite existing user rows. The controller/publisher alone integrates and verifies Production; leave N100 awaiting PO after real delivery.
